profile.headline: Software Engineer | .NET, C#, Azure, SQL | Backend & DevOps for Regulated Systems | Automations engineer | AI engineer
profile.summary:
I have the drive, ambition, and desire to become the best I can be in my career. That being said, I know the person I’m really competing against is myself.

I don’t mind being thrown into the deep end without a life vest. Give me the right team, the right tools, and enough time, and I believe we can figure almost anything out. 

I’m not afraid of the late nights when there’s something worth building, fixing, or learning — and if we don’t have the right tools, let’s make them.

I love automation. If I find myself doing the same thing three times, I’m already thinking about how I can script it, automate it, or build a bot to handle it. But automation is only useful if you can trust it. That means tracking results, reviewing reports, collecting feedback, and continuously improving the tools I build instead of assuming they’re always right.

I AM BIG ON RESPECT
Whether someone is just starting their career or sitting at the top of an organization, I believe people should be treated the way we would want to be treated ourselves, and even as I continue growing.I still deal with imposter syndrome sometimes. 

The funny thing is, the more I learn, the more I realize how much there still is to learn. That's one of my favorite things about technology and life in general. There's always another problem to solve, another skill to learn, and another version of yourself to build.

The worst thing we can do is never try. Failing is half the fun.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Handled complex field issues across multiple slot platforms, diagnosing and resolving software defects spanning embedded firmware, backend services, Unity-based UIs, and hardware integration layers.

Led player release management from development to SQA certification — coordinating with engineering, QA, and production teams to validate builds, track testing progress, and ensure timely approvals.

Designed, built, and maintained internal and external DevOps tools using .NET, C#, ASP.NET, Razor, and SQL, streamlining workflows for build validation, dependency comparison, and branch automation.

Implemented high- and low-level features across platform, DevOps, and core systems — from backend APIs and configuration frameworks to Unity front-end components and firmware communication layers.

Supported continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, improving release reliability and reducing human error through automation and dependency validation scripts.

positions.title: Founder & Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Founded and run a development studio building automation, internal tools, and AI assistants for small and mid-size businesses.
Delivered and deployed production client websites, handling design, build, hosting, and ongoing maintenance.
Built custom automation and integrations connecting business tools, chat platforms, and internal data sources.
Developed AI assistants grounded in client documentation — manuals, SOPs, and internal knowledge bases.
Manage the full engagement: scoping, pricing, delivery, and client communication.
positions.insights: Full-Stack Development, Web Development and +2 skills

positions.title: Business Development & Strategic Partnerships
positions.description:
Support business development and strategic partnerships for  construction company, focusing on client acquisition, project referrals, and relationship development.
• Identify and qualify potential residential and commercial construction opportunities.
• Connect clients with the appropriate construction professionals and skilled trades based on project needs.
• Coordinate introductions, estimates, client communication, and project handoffs to the operations team.
• Develop referral relationships with individuals and businesses that generate new project opportunities.
• Support digital marketing, lead generation, customer follow-up, and business growth initiatives.
• Help expand the company’s network of clients, partners, contractors, and specialty trades.
positions.insights: Business Development, Strategic Planning and +3 skills

projects.title: Grizzly Paths
projects.description:

Creation of an interface that maps out GGC courses to desired skills within the IT industry
UI was created by implementing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON
